notes.title: Update notes for version 1.21
notes.notes:
1. The default sea state is now closer to calm,
increased the chance for storms.
Original wave roughness can be be restored by setting option in Settings->Gameplay->Rough waves
2. You can no longer have more active crew than ship has crew capacity.
Exceeding crew is still stored.
3. Readjusted the UI for the Dockyard, making the stats comparison between ships easier.
Made also buying and changing of the equipment easier.
4. Fixed equipment and stats related bugs, polished UI relating to them also.
5. Switching between Crow's Nest and Deck View is now saved and next time spyglass is used it will default to the previously used view.
6. Fixed incorrect default key bindings being shown in the input menu.

notes.title: Trade update v1.20
notes.notes:
1. Reworked part of the trade system: part 1
   1.1 Each port now has an individual supply and demand.
   1.2 Added production/consumption icon to the trade window based on port's production
   1.3 Port's supply and demand can now be seen by clicking on the port's icon on the Map screen
   1.4 Added additional trade goods.
   1.5 Port's doubloons and trade goods are now saved. Preventing exploitation.
   1.6 Port's doubloons and items goes incrementally back to their default values after a half in game day
   1.7 Added additional trade related instructions to pirate-o-pedia
2. Ranking up again is now possible after reaching rank viceroy. Making gaining additional skill points possible
3. Fixed rare crash when save's timestamp is incorrect.

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.19
notes.notes:
1. Added Legendary Pirates that roam the Seven Seas and added a Wanted Board
for them in the Tavern. 
Bar keeper will sometimes reveal their locations, if you have high enough rank
2. Changed ship buoyancy, so that ships are less bouncy in waves
3. Fixed memory leak while looking at the map
4. Fixed issues with player ship being invulnerable

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.18
notes.notes:
1. Improved the skill bar usability (easier to replace skills and change the order etc.)
2. Rare items can now sometimes be found in the equipment store
3. Fixed crash relating to boarded ship being sunk and rare crash relating to NPC's ownership of flotsams
4. Fixed equipment flotsams sometimes showing up as empty.
5. Fixed two exploration locations sometimes being spawned on top of each other in the Mediterranean. Also reduced exploration location density there.
6. Small UI improvements.
7. Fixed sound volume not being applied to the rain

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.17
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the ship counting for El Dorado quest
2. Increased rare equipment drop rate.
3. Fixed a crash relating to spyglass
4. Victory now has 4 chasers

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.16
notes.notes:
1. Small upgrades to animations, interior texturing and lighting
2. Tooltips for towns no longer shown when hovering over exploration locations on the map
3. Max crew added to the captain menu
4. Stralsund now classified as medium frigate.
5. Fixed a soft lock while trading when the ship's cargo is over ship's maximum cargo capacity
6. Fixed multiple rare crashes.

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.15
notes.notes:
1. Readjusted sunsets brightness, so it no longer turns in to laser beam.
2. Main menu assets/island no longer appear in real space when specific exploration location at zero coordinates is interacted with.
3. Quest's enemy list HUD element no longer appear after the quest is completed

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.14
notes.notes:
1. Added Crow's Nest to most ships. Can be accessed by pressing Z button when using the spyglass.
2. Fixed multiple issues with sailing around the world (Travelling from America using pacific to Asia or vice versa)
3. Fixed rare issue of ships "warping/"shifting"

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.13
notes.notes:
1. Rebalanced some of the skills.
2. Rebalanced reload speed stacking (No more machine guns)
3. Fixed multiple issues with stats and equipment calculations in the stats/equipment screen while in dockyard.
4. Equipment stats are now correctly applied when game is loaded from save game.
5. Equipment flotsams should no longer spawn as empty
6. Ships turn rate is now affected by sail condition. 
7. Skill bar is now hidden when spy glass is used.
8. Reduced crew damage of barshot and cannonball since it was making scattershot redudant.
9. Fixed rebinding of movement keys and contextual arrow keys.
10. Rearranged the orders of the key bindings to be more grouped together and logical

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.12
notes.notes:
1. Fixed achievements that were not incremented correctly.
2. Capturing ships during port battles counts them as being destroyed.
3. Scuttling a surrender ship during port battles no longer counts as destroyed twice.
4. Improved quest handling of destroyed, surrendered or captured ships
and spawning of the ships with certain quests.
5 Press F to Dock should no longer flicker if two ports are nearby..

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.11
notes.notes:
1. Focus skills no longer run out of time.
2. Current navigation is now a passive skill
3. Fixed a bug where player's ports were reconquered by the NPCs if he was a pirate
4. Relandscaped terrain around certain ports to give easier access, prevent ships from spawning into land locked lakes and adjusted ship spawn points.
5. Fixed incorrect camera location and rotation with some ports.
6. Adjusted so that flag and flag pole are in the correct position for middle-eastern ports.
7. Removed honor rank related information for the captain stats. Since the feature was never implemented.

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.10
notes.notes:
1. Added trade XP. 
You can now receive XP from trading. Longer the journey, more valuable the goods and higher the volume, the more XP you will get.

notes.title: Update notes for patch v1.09 November 18th
notes.notes:
1. Waypoints now are correctly removed from compass when it is removed on the map or reached
2. Adjusted some ship model's flag poles and flags so they are now properly attached.
3. Added tutorial popup when new players try to start a new game.
4. Ships no longer miss fire in the main menu

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.08
notes.notes:
1. Town information now can be seen when hovering over it on a map
2. Enemies that are attacking you or your allies are now marked as bright red,
enemies that are not attacking you are marked as dark red in the minimap.
3. Fixed skills that affect enemies negatively, for instance rudder shot now immobilize enemies.
4. Fixed ship movement for very low end systems.
5. Adjusted native ships, now they are easier to sink.

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.07
notes.notes:
1. Player can now sell their purchased and captured ships
2. Proper ship is now ALWAYS received when capturing ships
3. Changed treasure island icon to differentiate it better from waypoint icon

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.06
notes.notes: 1. Fixed a bug that was causing enemy captains to turn their sailing ships into land ships

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.05
notes.notes:
1. Your ability to capture larger ships is now based on rank
2. Plundered port by NPCs vs NPCs now returns to correct state
3. Nations relations now saved correctly
4. Added proper wealth to the starting classes
5. Surrendered ships no longer try to escape
6. Added owners of items in to corresponding sides in the trade window

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.04
notes.notes:
1. Due to popular demand: Added gameplay setting for enabling raising ship's lower sails, instead of keeping them always folded.
2. Added gameplay setting for disabling sail against wind penalty
3. Added gameplay setting for disabling roaming sea monsters
4. Added input setting for inversing mouse Y

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.03
notes.notes:
1. You can now start as a captain of any of the 14 nations. Non-major nations can be found by pressing minor button next to the major nations
3. Game can be now paused by pressing pause button
2. Movement keys are now bindable
3. Ambient sound setting now saved correctly
4. Fixed some sound effects not taking audio settings into consideration
5. Ships list goes now in order from newest -> oldest in ship selection
6. Factions menu now is showing correct relation for selected nation

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.02
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug causing the sail maker to show up when pressing numpad key
2. Stores inventory restocks now after 1 in game day
3. Enemy nations no longer continuously try to reconquer player conquered ports.
4. Adjusted hitbox of Santisima Trinidad

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.01
notes.notes:
1. Fixed rare bug in which captured ship defaults to Victory
2. Captured Ships are now correctly added to player collection / available at Dockyard
3. Gold is now looted correctly from Flotsams
4. Capturable status (Yes/No) can now by detected by looking into ships with spyglass
5. Added Very Easy difficulty setting for those who like to take it easy

notes.notes: One hour demonstration of Terror of the Seven Seas Demo, by its creator.
